desc: For more than 45 years, Kimber has set the standard for exceptional 1911 pistols-designed, built, and perfected in America. That legacy continues with the introduction of the 1911 DS Warrior. Engineered for uncompromising performance, the DS Warrior features a superior finish, optics-ready capability, and a lightweight carbon fiber-infused grip. Each 1911 DS Warrior is hand-fitted, a level of craftsmanship unmatched by any imported high-capacity 1911. Proudly Always American Made, the 1911 DS Warrior delivers unparalleled value and uncompromising performance.
